title: STABILITY CONSTANTS OF COBALT (II) COMPLEXES OF TAURINE AND β-ALANINE
journal: IZVESTIYA VYSSHIKH UCHEBNYKH ZAVEDENIY KHIMIYA KHIMICHESKAYA TEKHNOLOGIYA

sections.abstract: <jats:p>The stability constants for cobalt (II) complexes of taurine and β-alanine were determinedwith the potentiometric method at 298.15K and at an ionic strength of 0.5 (KNO3).</jats:p>
